description.value: Woodrun Lodge is a ski-in/ski-out condominium-style property on the slopeside of Blackcomb Mountain in Whistler's Upper Village area, managed as vacation rentals by WhistlerAccommodation.com. Units feature fully equipped kitchens, washers/dryers, gas fireplaces, and wifi, with access to a shared heated outdoor pool and hot tub. A touring cyclist would find it a well-appointed mountain base with slope views and convenient access to both the Upper and Main villages.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record for Woodrun Lodge has a website URL (woodrunlodge.com) that resolves to WhistlerAccommodation.com, a vacation rental management company (Blackcomb Peaks) operating multiple Whistler properties including Woodrun units. The website confirms the property is a real, operating ski-in/ski-out condo lodge on Blackcomb Mountain with in-unit features including washer/dryer and wifi. Two discrepancies are flagged: OSM lists phone +1-604-905-4607 while the website shows 1-866-590-1613, and OSM lists the address as 4910 Spearhead Place while the website footer lists 4800 Spearhead Dr for the management company.
concerns: Phone mismatch: OSM lists +1-604-905-4607 but the management company website shows 1-866-590-1613.
Address mismatch: OSM lists '4910 Spearhead Place' but the management company website footer lists '4800 Spearhead Dr, Whistler, BC'.
woodrunlodge.com redirects to WhistlerAccommodation.com (Blackcomb Peaks), a multi-property rental management company; the lodge itself has no standalone direct web presence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating vacation rental lodge in Whistler with an active website and confirmed unit amenities; fully accessible to the public.
enrichment_extras.notes: The management company website includes a 'Bike Rentals' navigation link, suggesting cycling services may be available in some form through affiliated providers, but no on-site bike storage or handling details are described.
